categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Electric operates primarily in three segments: Energy Equipment, Industrial Equipment, and Integration Services. Energy Equipment includes nuclear power, coal-fired power, gas power, wind power, hydrogen energy, photovoltaic equipment, and power grid solutions. Industrial Equipment covers elevators, electric motors, intelligent manufacturing equipment, industrial basic parts, and construction industrialization equipment. Integration Services provide energy, environmental protection, automation engineering, industrial internet, financial services, and property management.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced manufacturing technologies including heavy-duty gas turbines, nuclear power equipment with high localization, offshore wind turbines, alkaline and PEM electrolyzers for hydrogen production, ultra-high voltage electrical equipment, and intelligent manufacturing technologies such as digital simulation and 3D printing. It employs digital and intelligent technologies for factory upgrades and uses advanced materials like titanium alloy for turbine blades. R&D emphasizes breakthroughs in energy storage, hydrogen energy, and precision manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Shanghai Electric serves national strategic industries, power generation companies, industrial manufacturers, aviation and aerospace sectors, urban rail transit operators, and new energy markets. Major customers include power plants, industrial enterprises, and government projects, with a focus on domestic Chinese markets and expanding overseas presence in over 50 countries along the Belt and Road Initiative. The top five customers accounted for 6.4% of total sales revenue in 2024.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Mainland China, which accounts for the majority of its revenue and assets, with significant operations and sales also in other countries and regions globally. It has over twenty overseas branches in countries including the UK, Japan, Australia, South Africa, Mexico, and Panama. The company is expanding its international market presence while maintaining a strong domestic base.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Electric operates primarily as a manufacturer and integrator in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It designs, manufactures, and sells high-end equipment and provides integration services including engineering, installation, and maintenance. It also engages in financial services and industrial internet services, positioning itself as a comprehensive equipment manufacturer and service provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes serving national strategies with a focus on high-quality development, technological self-reliance, and innovation. R&D efforts target breakthroughs in core technologies such as heavy-duty gas turbines, nuclear power equipment, renewable energy, energy storage, hydrogen energy, and intelligent manufacturing. It promotes digital transformation, open innovation ecosystems, and talent development to support green, intelligent, and high-end industrial upgrading.
categories.revenue_model: Shanghai Electric generates revenue through product sales of energy equipment, industrial equipment, and integrated services including engineering, maintenance, and financial services. Revenue is recognized from sales of goods, rendering of services, and construction contracts based on progress. The company also earns income from financial leasing, asset management, and other service fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the largest comprehensive equipment manufacturers in China with a leading position in offshore wind power, nuclear power equipment, and heavy-duty gas turbines. It competes with domestic and international manufacturers in power generation equipment, industrial machinery, and integration services. Shanghai Electric emphasizes its technological innovation, localization capabilities, and alignment with national strategies to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Shanghai Electric reported total revenue of RMB116.186 billion, a 1.2% increase year-on-year, with net profit attributable to owners of RMB752 million. The company has total assets of RMB302.5 billion and employs over 40,000 staff. It has shown steady revenue growth, increased cash flows from operations, and continues to invest significantly in R&D (4.9% of revenue). The company maintains a gearing ratio of approximately 42%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Electric offers high-end, green, and intelligent equipment solutions aligned with national energy and industrial strategies. Its value proposition includes advanced technology leadership in energy equipment (e.g., nuclear, wind, hydrogen), comprehensive integration services, and digital transformation capabilities. The company differentiates through localization of core technologies, innovation in energy storage and hydrogen, and providing turnkey smart factory solutions, supporting customers’ efficiency, sustainability, and modernization goals.
